title: UnStrained Apes
tagline: Tired of aping into rug pulls? Ape into UnStrained for 10 min a day to reduce eye fatigue instead.
description:
We believe people should ape into their health, so we created UnStrained Apes to provide web3 enthusiasts around the world access to video games that help to reduce eye strain.

We are building a community led platform that uses Unlock for token gated access to benefits for ApeCoin holders who also believe eye health is important.
how_its_made:
Our project primarily uses ApeCoin and Unlock Protocol to build a community for people wanting to improve their personal eye health and to build on the new technologies increasing access to eye care around the worls. As one of the most popular and innovative NFT communities in the modern world, ApeCoin users are the first community we are leveraging to increase healthcare awareness across web3 users, starting with eyecare. Future plans include integrations with other independent remote health solutions such as mental health, genetic health, lab results, and more so people can democratize their access to cafe.

Unlock Protocol provided the locks that token gate the site where we host the exercises and other health care hacks. As nov-devs, Unlock made it possible to sell NFTs for direct access to eyecare tools with almost zero coding experience. 

Together these two make an unbeatable combination for building community and with easily-minted NFTs for engagement and access to decentralized tele-medicine.
